environment.description: Service runs behind an internal NLB (Network Load Balancer) in a private subnet with no internet gateway. The NLB target group health check path is /api/v1/migration/status. Ingress to the NLB is controlled by a VPC security group that permits TCP/8443 only from three specific CIDR prefixes: 10.2.0.0/16 (corporate VPN egress), 172.20.4.0/22 (CI/CD runner subnet), and 192.168.100.0/24 (DBA jump host subnet). The private subnet route table has no route to an internet gateway or NAT gateway — only routes to the VPC CIDR and a VPC endpoint for S3. There is no VPC peering, Transit Gateway attachment, or PrivateLink consumer outside the account. DNS resolution for the NLB is via Route53 private hosted zone only (not publicly resolvable).

config.deployment: internal NLB, private subnet, no IGW/NAT
config.subnet_route_table: local VPC + S3 VPC endpoint only
config.internet_path: none (no IGW, no NAT, no peering, no TGW)
config.dns: Route53 private hosted zone, not publicly resolvable
